While at the [[Petranaki arena]], this '''acklay''' was used as the means to execute [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].

==Biography==
When [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], and Obi-Wan Kenobi were captured by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], this acklay was selected along with a [[Unidentified reek/Legends|Reek]] and a [[Unidentified nexu/Legends|Nexu]] to be the animals used to execute the three. The three managed to escape from their chains and fought back against the creatures until [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] arrived with [[Jedi assault team/Legends|reinforcements]]. At one point, Kenobi managed to stab the Acklay in the neck a stun pike, giving it some pain, only to remove the pike with its mouth and snap it in two. At another point, it also killed a Geonosian who had briefly been knocked out and tried to get out of the way by impaling the Geonosian with its pincers while moving towards Kenobi.<ref name="AOTC" />
[[File:Acklay_Obi-Wan.jpg|thumb|right|250px||Obi-Wan Kenobi facing the acklay]]
During the fight, Kenobi was found matched up with the acklay for a second time. Now armed with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], Kenobi killed the acklay by cutting off its two front-most legs and stabbing its neck.<ref name="AOTC" />
